title: directory-write-request
description: What write_json_validate_directory is handed: every file the generated directory is to hold, by its path relative to the directory root. A text entry is validated against its named schema and written in its format; a copy entry is the bytes of an existing file, as they are. Every file not listed is gone after the write. The writer also places its marker, .generated_directory.json, holding {"written_by": "write_json_validate_directory"}: the writer's proof of ownership. An existing folder without the marker is never replaced, and no request path may name it.
